blocks.text: SINGAPORE – As the anticipation builds for Alex Eala’s main draw debut here, Russian World No. 5 Mirra Andreeva put the Singapore Open on notice on Wednesday night. Andreeva reminded the rest of the field why she’s the top seed and the odds-on favorite to win it all. The 19-year-old Andreeva needed only an hour and 12 minutes to dispatch Belarusian Aliaksandra Sasnovich, 6-2, 6-2, in the round of 16 to begin her campaign.
